items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: I got a call to go to France to make a five day tour with Jo Jones, Milt Buckner, and T-Bone Walker.

ctx.x: Along those days. I had a friend whose mother ran away with one of those shows. He was a kid like I was, but his mother was very pretty and she ran away with the Drake and Walker Show
and never came back to Parsons.
